about: Exercise clips that passed the M1 clip review (30 Oct 2026; P4/media/clips/REVIEW.md). Each is named for what it shows; trimStart and trimEnd cut away an opening or a stretch that is unsafe or glitched; posterAt moves the poster where the middle frame does not show the exercise. Clips that failed are listed under dropped and are never transcoded, imported or mapped: their exercises stay text only. build_clips.py turns this into the folder media:import-exercises reads.
rights: Clips from the owner's earlier Fitterify app (generated video); rights confirmed by the owner on 30 Oct 2026; to be replaced with filmed clips.
source: Fitterify APK (Jun 18), assets/public/videos/{file}; generated video, passed the M1 clip review on 30 Oct 2026
